post.description:
O'z savollarining Rasch qiyinlik parametrini (irt_b) haqiqiy
javob tarixi (test.enwis.uz amaliyoti + ro'yxatdan o'tilgan
imtihonlar) asosida qayta hisoblaydi. Yangi javoblar to'planganda
vaqti-vaqti bilan qayta chaqirilishi tavsiya etiladi.

Rasch modeliga asoslangan test yaratadi: berilgan maqsadli
qobiliyat darajasiga (`target_theta`) eng mos, eng informativ
savollarni tanlab, ulardan yangi (qoralama) Test tuziladi.
Savollar avval `/tests/rasch/calibrate` orqali kalibrlangan
bo'lishi kerak (yoki `require_calibrated=false`).

Flips visibility to public and returns the test.enwis.uz URL —
this is the bridge between the two front-ends.

TeacherOverview.title: TeacherOverview
TeacherOverview.description:
Headline numbers for a teacher's own dashboard.

``total_students`` / ``active_students`` / ``student_growth_30d`` are
computed from *activity* (distinct users who attempted this teacher's
Tests or Exams) — there is no dedicated student-roster table yet. Once
the Student Management module ships, these should be redefined against
the roster (enrolled students) rather than pure attempt history.

provided by the Telegram client SDK, do not parse/modify it.
